functionalReqs: Hotels with room types and rooms
Search availability for a date range
Book rooms; cancel with policy-based refund
Check-in and check-out; add services (room service) to the bill
hints: How do you check whether a room is free for a date range efficiently?
Booking moves through states; refunds depend on a policy.

Hotel, RoomType, Room, Booking (State: Reserved, CheckedIn, CheckedOut, Cancelled), RoomAvailability per date (or interval tree), PricingStrategy (seasonal, weekend), CancellationPolicy strategy, Invoice with line items; booking a range locks rooms in ID order.
nonFunctionalReqs: No overlapping bookings for a room
problemStatement: Design the classes for a **hotel booking** system: search rooms by date range and type, book, check in and out, and cancel with a refund policy.
title: Design a Hotel Booking System
